name: Moonlight Blue
source:
Main character enters the desired university. His education life is very fun, but the apartment he moves into appears to be inhabited by a ghost girl...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角进入了理想的大学。他的教育生活很有趣，但他搬进的公寓里似乎住着一个幽灵女孩……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
